comment: delaySamples is computed inside the branch that runs only when the time control or the range switch changes, and it is computed from slewedTime, which is updated afterwards (Spatializer.cpp:90-100 and :111). The delay therefore tracks the knob only while the knob is actually moving, and settles wherever the slew had reached when the movement stopped. The buffer holds 2880 samples (Spatializer.cpp:58), more than the 30ms or 50 samples the controls can ask for at ordinary sample rates.
